description: This file defines the NoteService class, which provides core business logic for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes in a notes backend application. It interacts with the NoteRepository, manages note data transformations through NoteMapper, and handles exceptions when notes are not found.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for notes including create, read, update, and delete, with transaction support and validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request data, converting the request to an entity and saving it in the repository.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID or throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Returns a list of notes for a specific user, ordered by last update date descending.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note after validating ownership, applying changes via NoteMapper, within a transactional context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note if it belongs to the specified user, throwing NotFoundException otherwise.
